docs.title: Zephy
docs.text:
My personal voice assistant. It started as a local assistant on an Ollama / Qwen backend and is now a Jarvis-style agent on my own machine that can place calls, schedule meetings and work on projects with me and others.

Local LLMOllamaQwenVoice assistantTelegramTailscale

Architecture Evolution Source available on request

docs.title: What Zephy does
docs.text:
• Places calls and schedules meetings
  • Works on projects with me and with other people
  • Runs locally on hardware I own, with no paid API keys

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
flowchart LR
  ME[Me: text or voice] -->|Telegram| AG[Zephy agent]
  AG --> LLM[Local LLM<br/>Ollama · Qwen]
  AG --> TOOLS[Tools: calls, calendar, browser, files]
  subgraph Home server
    AG
    LLM
    TOOLS
  end
  ME -. remote access .-> TS[Tailscale] -.-> AG
Piece Choice Host ASUS Zephyrus G14 (32 GB RAM, RTX 4070) converted into a 24/7 home AI server Model backend Local models via Ollama (Qwen family) Interface Messaging through Telegram, voice on the machine Remote access Tailscale Wake behaviour Sleeps until messaged; a light heartbeat checks email and only pings me when something matters

docs.title: Evolution
docs.text: Zephy began as a local assistant answering questions on an Ollama / Qwen backend. Nine upgrades later it is an agent that takes actions: calls, scheduling and project work, from anywhere.

docs.title: Next
docs.text:
• Move the home server from Windows to Ubuntu
  • Shared memory and tool layer so every assistant I use sees the same knowledge
  • Edge hardware (Jetson) for always-on, low-power operation
